{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVlzVyc8AAAABeKyitQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BqjeczhHrl5Y", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bqjec", "number": 22, "title": "Simplify the initial v2 patch design and decouple the command roadmap", "body": "## Problem

The v2 proposal in #16 gives Cognix a useful way to review several file changes together, but the initial milestone includes decisions that are not needed for a read-only preview or for the first usable patch workflow.

In #20 / PR #21, the initial rule to reject any source extended attribute blocks ordinary test files on a macOS host that attaches `com.apple.provenance`. Five native cases have been skipped even though the planner makes no writes. The proposed move-with-edit operation also adds behavior beyond moving a file and updating references in other files. Separately, the roadmap makes a read-only command wrapper wait for v2 patch model evaluation, although those changes can be assessed independently.

## Expected outcome

Revise [the tool architecture decision](docs/tool-architecture.md) and affected guidance so the first v2 patch release covers common editing workflows with a small, testable contract. Keep the existing project boundary, approval preview, stale-file checks, no-clobber publication and accurate partial-result reporting. Retain the current v1 interface during the experimental rollout.

This is a design revision. Include the exact acceptance-criteria changes to carry into #20 and its existing PR, so the planner can be adjusted in one place. Keep executor and command-backend implementation in their respective milestones.

## Context and reproduction

- #16 describes the target workflows, including creating a nested module, moving a module and updating references, and removing an obsolete test.
- #20 implements the parser and read-only planner in #21. The [review evidence](https://github.com/takahirox/cognix/issues/20#issuecomment-6770667635) records five cases blocked by the host's persistent provenance attribute.
- The architecture's initial metadata policy, operation shapes, local-model evaluation and ordered roadmap are the sections to revise.

## Mandatory pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] **AC1 — Keep preview usable on ordinary files.** Separate read-only planning from permission to execute. A source extended attribute alone must not prevent building a preview. Record relevant metadata constraints for execution. The future executor must verify that the operation can handle the source metadata safely before writing, and report unsupported cases without discarding attributes. Keep the path, file identity, symlink and destination checks. Give #20 revised AC4/AC7 wording that allows native planning fixtures with ordinary OS attributes and still checks zero target mutations, stale-file detection and applicable metadata behavior.
- [ ] **AC2 — Simplify the initial move operation.** Use a move to an absent destination without editing that same file within the move record. Keep the ability to move a file and update other files in one reviewed patch. Align the JSON examples, field rules, preview, tests and roadmap with that contract. List move-with-edit as later work if a concrete need arises.
- [ ] **AC3 — Separate patch delivery from command expansion.** Remove the dependency of the read-only command wrapper on v2 patch model evaluation. Keep the existing command path usable. Treat build isolation, project-write import and Git inspection as independent extensions with their existing containment prerequisites.
- [ ] **AC4 — Evaluate the model-facing format early and with a small sample.** Specify a small trial for common tasks such as adding a file and editing several files. Use the result to inform the schema before broad rollout. Reserve the fuller legacy/v2 comparison for making v2 the default or retiring legacy interfaces. Keep model trials outside the acceptance criteria of the internal planner.
- [ ] **AC5 — Keep the revised design internally consistent.** Check the operation examples, approval and mutation rules, test expectations, linked guides and milestone dependencies against AC1–AC4. Run `cargo run --locked --example check_docs` and `git diff --check` for the documentation change, and record the actual results.

## Validation already performed

**Pass (design review):** Reviewed the architecture decision, #16, #20 and the recorded review of #21. Confirmed that the current plan rejects source extended attributes and that the roadmap orders the read-only wrapper after the patch model trial.

**Not run:** Documentation checks for the proposed revision. Run them on the implementing PR.

## Optional validation

None required.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

See the [review and merge guidelines](docs/review-guidelines.md).
